mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO bookmark (member_id, campaign_id) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{campaignId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM bookmark WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND campaign_id = #{campaignId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.* FROM bookmark b JOIN campaign c ON c.campaign_id = b.campaign_id WHERE b.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY b.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM campaign WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId}
